strings.name: Guillermo del Toro
strings.role: Film director · Fantasy and animation creator
strings.summary: Raised in Guadalajara, del Toro moved from makeup effects and shorts to features. He combines monsters and fairy tales with war history, working in Spanish and English. Pan’s Labyrinth and The Shape of Water exemplify his work; the latter earned him the directing Oscar. Pinocchio, co-directed with Mark Gustafson, won animated feature, and Frankenstein followed in 2025.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Combines monster fables with social history, expanding fantasy-film expression through Pan’s Labyrinth, The Shape of Water and other works.
